text:
laura: Heads-up — canary p95 jumped after last night's merge. Short-seq tail from ~80ms -> ~230ms. Suspect prefetch sampler change in runtime.
ci-bot: CI perf check: decode_p95 increased 2.9x on canary (regression detected). See: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
simon: Oof. Which PR? any obvious stack traces from perf job?
laura: Merge was #4321 (prefetch sampling refactor). Rollout started at 7000000000.
cheng: Quick flame snapshot from canary profiler (short seq workload):
```
hot 48%  prefetch_sampler::sample_hotpaths
hot 22%  kv_cache::evict_if_needed
hot 12%  attn_kernel::dispatch()
hot 8%   fused_matmul::run()
```
Looks like sampler is in a tight loop triggering kv evictions on warmups.
simon: That matches observed KV churn metrics — eviction rate spiked ~3x at warmup window.
nate: Can we reproduce locally on small repro? Perf bot trace points to prefetch_sampler allocating and spinning when batch_size=1.
cheng: Repro steps I used:
```
./run_local_load --model redwood/7b --seq 64 --batch 1 --prefetch-mode=sampled
perf record -g ./inference_bin
```
Got identical flame: prefetch sampler -> kv eject -> decode stall.
katherine: Hold rollout? We should pause canary promotion until triage complete. Also consider reverting PR 4321 if bisect pins it.
laura: Hold applied. Not promoting further. tagging @eng-oncall for additional eyes.
simon: I'll start a bisect range 6998000000..7002000000 and try to isolate commit. If it points to 4321, we should revert asap.
cheng: Quick grep shows the refactor added a while-loop that retries prefetch when cache miss rate > threshold. Patch simplified logic but removed backoff.
```
while (should_prefetch && cache_miss_rate > thr) { prefetch(); }
```

simon: If bisect confirms, revert or add exponential backoff. Nate, can you prototype a minimal backoff guard? Even a sleep+cap should flatten p95.
nate: Yep, will whip a small patch: add backoff iterations and max_prefetch_per_step. Will test on canary.
laura: Also need a CI perf run with shortseq/regression guard before merging fix.
katherine: Filing incident ticket and linking PRs. I'll also flag support for customers on dedicated who might hit this.
cheng: For triage notes: profiler shows hotloop on CPU side but GPU utilization drops during stalls — kv evict causes decode stalls waiting for KV refill.
simon: Bisect update: narrowed to 7000012345 -> 7000015678, suspect commit 7000014001 (the refactor create). Running a revert test now.
ci-bot: Perf job re-run queued against revert candidate.
laura: Thanks. If revert fixes, roll back to previous prefetch logic and iterate on sampled approach with backoff test coverage.
nate: Patch ready on branch fix/prefetch-backoff, running repro now.
cheng: If revert not possible fast, put canary capacity into static routing to older model variant as emergency fallback.
katherine: Agreed. I'll coordinate with infra to route small percentage away until fix lands. :thumbsup:
laura: Good plan. Next steps: simon completes bisect + revert test, nate validates backoff patch, cheng gathers profiler dumps for postmortem. Meeting in 30 for quick sync. :clock1:
